item.title: [翻译] TLDR AI: GPT-5.6 预览、Grok 4.5 内测与谷歌限制 Meta
item.description:
标签: #AI #大模型 #科技资讯

摘要: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5.6 Preview 模型家族（Sol、Terra 和 Luna），并加强安全测试；马斯克宣布 Grok 4.5 已在 SpaceX 和特斯拉开启内测，早期评测接近或超过 Opus。此外，Google reportedly 因算力不足限制了 Meta 对 Gemini 的使用，导致后者部分 AI 项目延期。

原标题: GPT-5.6 preview ☀️, Grok 4.5 beta 🤖, Google limits Meta 🛑

TLDR AI 2026-06-29

TLDR AI 2026-06-29

GPT-5.6 preview ☀️, Grok 4.5 beta 🤖, Google limits Meta 🛑

GPT-5.6 预览 ☀️，Grok 4.5 测试版 🤖，Google 限制 Meta 🛑

Musk Says Grok 4.5 Entered Private Beta (1 minute read)

Musk 称 Grok 4.5 进入非公开测试（1 分钟阅读）

Elon Musk said Grok 4.5 was in private beta at SpaceX and Tesla. The model is based on a 1.5T V9 foundation model with Cursor data added during supplemental training. Early evaluations were near or above Opus, with reinforcement learning still improving the model.

Elon Musk 表示，Grok 4.5 正在 SpaceX 和 Tesla 进行 private beta（非公开测试）。该模型基于 1.5T V9 foundation model（基础模型），并在补充训练中加入了 Cursor 的数据。早期评测结果接近或超过 Opus，且 reinforcement learning（强化学习） 仍在持续改进模型。

GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna (39 minute read)

GPT-5.6 Sol、Terra 与 Luna（39 分钟阅读）

OpenAI introduced GPT-5.6 Preview, a family of models named Sol, Terra, and Luna, with Sol positioned as the flagship model. The system card describes stronger cyber and bio safety testing, new safeguards, and a limited preview before broader availability.

OpenAI 发布了 GPT-5.6 Preview，这是一组名为 Sol、Terra 和 Luna 的模型，其中 Sol 定位为旗舰模型。System card（系统说明卡） 描述了更强的网络与生物安全测试、新的防护措施，以及在更广泛开放前的 limited preview（限量预览）。

Google Limiting Meta's Gemini Use (2 minute read)

Google 限制 Meta 使用 Gemini（2 分钟阅读）

Google reportedly limited Meta's access to Gemini capacity after Meta requested more compute than Google could provide. The shortfall was said to have delayed some internal Meta AI projects and pushed staff to use AI tokens more efficiently.

据报道，Google 在 Meta 请求了超过自身可提供的 compute（算力） 后，限制了 Meta 对 Gemini 容量的使用。据称这一缺口推迟了 Meta 的一些内部 AI 项目，并促使员工更高效地使用 AI tokens。

Memory Prices report from Stanford (4 minute read)

斯坦福发布内存价格报告（4 分钟阅读）

Stanford published an interactive report on historic and current memory and storage prices. The dataset follows the spirit of John C. McCallum's classic memory-price work, with downloadable raw data and chart export tools.

Stanford（斯坦福大学） 发布了一份关于历史与当前 memory and storage prices（内存与存储价格） 的交互式报告。该数据集秉承 John C. McCallum 经典内存价格工作的精神，提供 downloadable raw data（可下载原始数据） 与图表导出工具。

The Next Paradigm (7 minute read)

下一个范式（7 分钟阅读）

AI labs are betting that scaling reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) across millions of diverse tasks will achieve artificial general intelligence (AGI), but this paradigm hits a wall in domains that lack deterministic simulators. True continual learning requires moving past temporary in-context memory and shifting back into the model's weights themselves.

AI labs（人工智能实验室）正押注于：在数百万多样化任务上扩展 reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards（RLVR，基于可验证奖励的强化学习），以实现 artificial general intelligence（AGI，通用人工智能）。但这一范式在缺乏 deterministic simulators（确定性模拟器） 的领域会遇到瓶颈。真正的 continual learning（持续学习） 需要超越临时的 in-context memory（上下文记忆），转而回到模型权重本身。

Lean Software Scaling Laws (17 minute read)

Lean 软件扩展定律（17 分钟阅读）

Codebases and programming languages will eventually become easier for AI models to understand, fix, and write. The Lean programming language has a worse baseline constant and total loss on existing code bases compared to other languages, but better scaling components. This implies that implementations in Lean could eventually win and deliver large benefits in program correctness at global scale.

代码库和编程语言终将对 AI 模型来说变得更易理解、修复和编写。Lean programming language（Lean 编程语言） 在现有代码库上的 baseline constant（基线常数） 和总损失比其他语言更差，但其扩展组件更优。这意味着用 Lean 实现的代码最终可能胜出，并在全球范围内为 program correctness（程序正确性） 带来巨大收益。

Moneyball for Physical AI (26 minute read)

物理人工智能领域的“点球成金”策略（26 分钟阅读）

Data engineering pipelines should deprecate cumulative operational hours as a primary metric. Engineering efficiency and model scaling should be evaluated using quantifiable parameters. An optimal capital allocation strategy balances data types against their specific utility metrics. Capital efficiency scales by accurately pricing data novelty.

Physical AI（物理人工智能）的数据工程流程应不再把 cumulative operational hours（累计运行时长） 作为主要指标。工程效率与模型扩展应通过 quantifiable parameters（可量化参数） 来评估。最优的 capital allocation（资本配置） 策略会根据具体效用指标平衡数据类型。通过准确地为 data novelty（数据新颖性） 定价，资本效率才能扩展。

👨‍💻

👨‍💻

Engineering & Research

工程与研究

Stuck in a botsitting cycle? (Sponsor)

陷入 botsitting 循环？（赞助商）

The Work AI Index 2026 from Glean's Work AI Institute surveyed 6,000 digital workers and found that AI saves time, but much of it goes back into cleanup. Read the report to see where AI time savings go and what high AI achievers do differently.

Download the report

Glean 的 Work AI Institute（工作人工智能研究所） 发布的 Work AI Index 2026（2026 年工作人工智能指数） 调查了 6,000 名数字工作者，发现 AI 确实节省时间，但其中很大一部分又被用于清理善后。阅读报告可了解 AI 节省的时间去向何处，以及 high AI achievers（AI 高绩效者） 有何不同做法。

下载报告

Qwen Image Agent (12 minute read)

Qwen 图像智能体（12 分钟阅读）

Qwen-Image-Agent improved text-to-image generation by planning, reasoning, searching, using memory, and incorporating feedback to fill in missing user context. The work also introduced IA-Bench to test agentic image generation across planning, reasoning, search, and memory.

Qwen-Image-Agent 通过规划、推理、搜索、使用记忆并引入反馈来补全缺失的用户上下文，从而改进了 text-to-image generation（文本到图像生成）。该工作还引入了 IA-Bench，用于在规划、推理、搜索和记忆方面测试 agentic image generation（智能体图像生成）。

Accelerating Gemini Nano models on Pixel with frozen Multi-Token Prediction (10 minute read)

通过冻结多 Token 预测加速 Pixel 上的 Gemini Nano 模型（10 分钟阅读）

Models like Gemini Nano and Gemma make it possible to have powerful large language models right in your pocket. Delivering these models on mobile was a significant challenge. Google built a new architecture that retrofits Multi-Token Prediction onto existing 'frozen' Gemini Nano v3 models to overcome the bottleneck. The new architectural components were designed to maximize efficiency gains specifically for mobile environments. This article shows how Google's research team tackled the unique, extreme constraints of edge computing.

Gemini Nano 和 Gemma 等模型让强大的大语言模型随身携带成为可能。在移动设备上部署这些模型曾是一项重大挑战。Google 构建了一种新架构，将 Multi-Token Prediction（多 Token 预测） 改装到现有“frozen”（冻结）的 Gemini Nano v3 模型上，以突破瓶颈。新的架构组件专为移动环境最大化效率增益而设计。本文介绍了 Google 研究团队如何应对 edge computing（边缘计算） 独特且极端的约束。

Reward Models Can Be Too Sensitive (22 minute read)

奖励模型可能过于敏感（22 分钟阅读）

Meta studied how reward models can overreact to equally good responses, leading reinforcement learning toward reward hacking. The paper proposes measuring both discriminative ability and specificity, then using Monte Carlo dropout to cluster rewards into safer discrete signals.

Meta 研究了 reward models（奖励模型） 如何会对同样优质的回复反应过度，从而将强化学习引向 reward hacking（奖励操纵/奖励破解）。论文建议同时衡量区分能力与特异性，然后使用 Monte Carlo dropout（蒙特卡洛 dropout） 将奖励聚类成更安全的离散信号。

TLDR is hiring a Senior PMM ($180k-$225k base + $40-50k annual target bonus, Fully Remote)

TLDR 正在招聘高级产品营销经理（底薪 18–22.5 万美元 + 年度目标奖金 4–5 万美元，全远程）

We're hiring a Senior PMM to own product marketing at TLDR. You'll define our positioning, build out sales enablement, and lead every launch.

TLDR 正在招聘一名 Senior PMM（高级产品营销经理），负责 product marketing（产品营销）。你将定义我们的定位、搭建 sales enablement（销售赋能） 体系，并主导每一次产品发布。

Claude Code turned every engineer into three. Now companies need more product thinkers (8 minute read)

Claude Code 让每位工程师顶三个，现在企业更需要产品思维者（8 分钟阅读）

AI coding agents have dramatically increased engineering output, shifting the bottleneck from writing code to deciding what to build. As software development becomes more automated, engineers who combine strong technical fundamentals with product judgment, customer insight, and code review skills are becoming increasingly valuable.

AI coding agents（AI 编程智能体） 极大提升了工程产出，瓶颈已从“写代码”转移到“决定做什么”。随着软件开发日益自动化，兼具扎实技术基础、product judgment（产品判断力）、customer insight（客户洞察力） 和代码审查技能的工程师正变得越来越有价值。

Agents as Webs of Beliefs (11 minute read)

作为信念网络的智能体（11 分钟阅读）

A proposed framework models intelligent agents as interconnected webs of beliefs, where beliefs, goals, and actions emerge from the same underlying structure instead of being treated separately. The approach argues that reasoning, planning, and decision-making arise from maintaining locally consistent belief networks, offering an alternative foundation for building more capable AI agents.

一个被提出的框架将智能体建模为相互关联的 webs of beliefs（信念网络），其中信念、目标和行动源自同一底层结构，而非被分别处理。该方法认为，reasoning（推理）、planning（规划） 和 decision-making（决策） 源于维护局部一致的 belief networks（信念网络），为构建更强大的 AI 智能体提供了另一种基础。

item.title: [翻译] Lenny's Newsletter: 无 Figma、无 Jira、无文档：Gusto 如何用 Claude Code 打造新产品线
item.description:
标签: #AI编程 #敏捷开发 #小团队 #产品创新

摘要: Gusto 联合创始人兼 CTO Eddie Kim 带领一名设计师和三名工程师，在 10 周内从零代码打造出全新 AI 产品线 Gusto Cofounder；他们弃用了 Figma、Jira 和传统文档流程，转而以 Claude Code、AI 工具、实时协作和“写完即删”的 PR 决策法完成上线。

原标题: No Figma. No Jira. No docs. How Gusto built a new product line with Claude Code | Eddie Kim (CTO)

No Figma. No Jira. No docs. How Gusto built a new product line with Claude Code | Eddie Kim (CTO)

没有 Figma，没有 Jira，没有文档。Gusto 如何用 Claude Code 打造一条新产品线 | Eddie Kim（CTO）

Eddie Kim is the co-founder and CTO of the payroll and HR platform Gusto, which just crossed $1 billion in revenue and serves more than 500,000 small businesses. Recently he did something most CTOs don’t: he went back to writing code. With three other engineers and one designer, Eddie built Gusto Cofounder, a net-new AI product, from zero code to a tier-one launch in 10 weeks. He walks through how that team actually worked, why they threw out nearly every process, and how anyone can copy the approach.

Eddie Kim 是薪资与人力平台 Gusto 的联合创始人兼 CTO（首席技术官），该公司收入刚突破 10 亿美元，服务超过 50 万家小企业。最近他做了一件大多数 CTO 不会做的事：重新回去写代码。与另外三名工程师和一名设计师一起，Eddie 在 10 周内把 Gusto Cofounder 这款 全新的 AI 产品（net-new AI product） 从零行代码推进到了 一级发布（tier-one launch）。他详细介绍了这支团队实际如何协作、为什么几乎抛弃了所有流程，以及任何人如何复制这种方法。

Listen or watch on YouTube, Spotify, or Apple Podcasts.

可在 YouTube、Spotify 或 Apple Podcasts 收听或观看。

What you’ll learn:

你将学到什么：

  • The trash-can method: how to write, review, and delete a full PR as a product decision instead of a planning doc
  • The two-tool agent stack behind Gusto Cofounder
  • The exact “perma-Zoom” setup that replaced standups, retros, and Slack threads for 10 weeks
  • How a designer with no engineering background hit the 94th percentile for shipping code
  • The eval-first workflow Eddie uses to fix real customer bugs with Claude Code
  • How a non-technical leader can prototype an idea to win buy-in, then carry it all the way to production-quality code

  • 垃圾桶法（trash-can method）：如何撰写、评审并删掉一整个 PR（Pull Request，合并请求），把它当作产品决策而非计划文档（planning doc）

item.title: [翻译] Lenny's Newsletter: 我如何用AI：GLM-5.2实测，以及Gusto如何用Claude Code打造新产品线
item.description:
标签: #GLM-5.2 #开源模型 #AI编程 #Claude Code

摘要: 本文通过两个案例展示了AI工程化的最新实践：Claire在真实代码库中实测发现，Z.ai开源的GLM-5.2已接近Claude Opus水平，具备百万token上下文、低成本与可自托管优势，但在复杂React代理任务中稳定性仍需验证；Gusto CTO Eddie Kim则分享了一个五人团队在没有PM、Figma和Jira的情况下，仅凭Claude Code和极简流程，在10周内从零推出新产品线，说明以AI为核心成员重新设计流程能极大压缩协作成本并加速上线。

原标题: 🎙️ How I AI: GLM-5.2 review & How Gusto built a new product line with Claude Code

🎙️ How I AI: GLM-5.2 review & How Gusto built a new product line with Claude Code

🎙️ How I AI：GLM-5.2 评测，以及 Gusto 如何借助 Claude Code 打造新产品线

GLM-5.2: why I’m replacing Opus in Claude Code with this new model

GLM-5.2：我为何要用这款新模型替换 Claude Code 中的 Opus

Listen now on YouTube • Spotify • Apple Podcasts

在 YouTube • Spotify • Apple Podcasts 收听本期节目。

Brought to you by: Mercury — Radically different banking, loved by over 300K entrepreneurs

赞助商：Mercury — 颠覆传统银行业务，深受 30 多万创业者喜爱。

Brought to you by:
  • Mercury — Radically different banking, loved by over 300K entrepreneurs

本期由以下品牌赞助：

• Mercury — 颠覆传统银行业务，深受 30 多万创业者喜爱。

Claire tests GLM-5.2, the new open-weight model from Z.ai, inside her actual ChatPRD codebase. She runs it through codebase audits, UI redesigns, and a 45-minute autonomous bug-hunting task in Cursor and Claude Code, and breaks down where it surprised her, where it struggled, and why it may be good enough to replace Opus for some coding workflows.

Claire 在自己真实的 ChatPRD 代码库中测试了 Z.ai 最新发布的 open-weight（开放权重）模型 GLM-5.2。她用它完成代码库审计、UI 重设计，以及在 Cursor 和 Claude Code 中运行了一场长达 45 分钟的自主 bug 狩猎任务，并分析了它令人惊喜的地方、遇到的困难，以及为什么它在某些编码工作流中已足以替代 Opus。

Biggest takeaways:

核心要点：

  • Open-weight models are no longer a hobbyist curiosity—they are production-grade alternatives. GLM-5.2, built by Beijing-based Z.ai, benchmarks near Claude Opus 4.8 and above GPT-5.5 on SWE Bench Pro, with a million-token context window and full support for reasoning mode, function calling, structured output, and context caching. The decision is no longer about capability ceilings but, instead, about cost, control, and vendor dependency. Claire’s live testing confirmed it: this is not a toy.
  • Self-hosting changes the vendor power dynamic in ways that matter at scale. Open-weight means the trained model weights are publicly available, letting teams run inference on their own hardware, fine-tune on proprietary data, and route around any single provider’s API terms. When frontier labs change pricing or policy, teams using open-weight models can switch inference providers without touching a line of application code. The key: you’re not locked in.
  • Getting GLM-5.2 running in Cursor took 30 minutes, and Claire documented the undocumented part. Route your API key through Open Router, override the OpenAI base URL in Cursor’s settings to openrouter.ai/api/v1/cursor (the /cursor suffix isn’t documented anywhere), and add z-ai/glm-5.2 as a custom model. Claude Code requires two environment variable changes and one edit to claude/settings.json. Total time: under an hour, once you have the exact strings.
  • The 45-minute autonomous task revealed both the ceiling and the floor. Claire gave GLM-5.2 a single prompt inside Claude Code: pull the last 72 hours of Sentry errors and Vercel logs, then build a prioritized bug-fix plan. Over 45 minutes, it ran MCP tool calls, authenticated into external services, and produced a dark-mode engineering canvas with 20 Sentry errors, five Vercel log signals, and 14 planned fixes, including two P0s Claire hadn’t spotted through normal monitoring. The model surfaced signal-to-noise issues in their error pipeline that weren’t showing up elsewhere.
  • It hit a wall with React, then recovered. During the long-running task, GLM-5.2 struggled with TypeScript compilation errors before eventually producing clean React output. Claire’s read: HTML and CSS generation is reliable; React under agentic, multi-step pressure is shakier. For teams whose codebase is primarily React (she estimates it covers 98% of her own use), this is the friction point to test before committing the model to critical paths.
  • The cost math is striking: $3.36 for 6 million tokens, including the full 45-minute agentic session. A 72% cache rate helped, but even at full price, open-weight inference through Open Router sits well below Opus or GPT-5.5 rates for equivalent coding capability. For agents accumulating long context windows over extended sessions (the exact workload where frontier model costs compound fastest), open-weight alternatives offer a structurally different cost curve.
  • Claire’s recommendation: put GLM-5.2 in rotation, not in the spotlight. She’s keeping it in Cursor for frontend and design work, and in Claude Code for long-running agentic tasks, alongside closed frontier models rather than as a replacement. The constraint she’s watching: can it handle her React-heavy workload at the same consistency she gets from Composer? If it can, the cost-and-control argument gets much harder to ignore.

1. 开放权重模型不再是爱好者的玩物，而是已经可用于生产环境的替代方案。总部位于北京的 Z.ai 打造的 GLM-5.2，在 SWE Bench Pro 上的基准表现接近 Claude Opus 4.8、超过 GPT-5.5，并拥有百万 token 的 context window（上下文窗口），完整支持 reasoning mode（推理模式）、function calling（函数调用）、structured output（结构化输出）和 context caching（上下文缓存）。选择模型不再只看能力上限，而是看成本、可控性和对厂商的依赖。Claire 的实测证明：这不是玩具。

2. 自托管正在改变厂商之间的权力格局，并在规模化时产生实质影响。开放权重意味着训练好的模型权重公开可用，团队可以在自己的硬件上运行 inference（推理），用专有数据 fine-tune（微调），并绕过单一服务商的 API 条款。当前沿实验室调整价格或政策时，使用开放权重模型的团队无需改动一行应用代码就能切换推理供应商。关键是：你不会被锁定。

3. 在 Cursor 中接入 GLM-5.2 花了 30 分钟，Claire 还记录了官方没有说明的部分。你需要把 API key 经由 Open Router 转发，在 Cursor 设置里把 OpenAI base URL 覆盖为 openrouter.ai/api/v1/cursor（/cursor 后缀在任何文档里都没提到），并把 z-ai/glm-5.2 添加为自定义模型。Claude Code 则需要修改两个环境变量，并编辑 claude/settings.json。只要拿到这些准确的字符串，全程不到一小时。

4. 这场 45 分钟的自主任务同时展现了它的上限和下限。Claire 在 Claude Code 里只给 GLM-5.2 发了一个指令：拉取过去 72 小时的 Sentry 错误和 Vercel 日志，然后生成一份按优先级排序的 bug 修复计划。在 45 分钟内，它执行了 MCP tool calls，完成外部服务认证，并输出了一份深色模式的工程看板，包含 20 条 Sentry 错误、5 条 Vercel 日志信号和 14 项修复计划，其中包括两个 Claire 通过常规监控未能发现的 P0 问题。模型还暴露了他们错误管道中别处没有显现的信噪比问题。

5. 它在 React 上撞了墙，但随后恢复了。在这场长时间任务中，GLM-5.2 一度在 TypeScript 编译错误上挣扎，最终才输出干净的 React 代码。Claire 的判断是：HTML 和 CSS 生成很可靠；但在 agentic（自主代理式）、多步骤的压力下，React 表现更不稳定。对于主要使用 React 的团队（她估计自己 98% 的场景都是 React），这是把模型投入关键路径前必须测试的摩擦点。

6. 成本数字非常惊人：600 万 token 只需 3.36 美元，还包括整场 45 分钟的 agentic 会话。72% 的缓存命中率帮了忙，但即便按全价计算，通过 Open Router 调用开放权重推理，其价格也远低于同等编码能力下 Opus 或 GPT-5.5 的费率。对于在长时间会话中累积长 上下文的智能体（这正是前沿模型成本快速叠加的典型场景），开放权重替代方案提供了一条结构性不同的成本曲线。

7. Claire 的建议是：让 GLM-5.2 进入轮换阵容，而不是独挑大梁。她会把它留在 Cursor 里做前端和设计工作，也放在 Claude Code 里执行长时间 agentic 任务，与闭源前沿模型并行使用，而非直接替代。她关注的约束是：它能否像 Composer 那样稳定地处理她以 React 为主的工作负载？如果可以，那么成本和可控性的理由将变得难以忽视。

No Figma. No Jira. No docs. How Gusto built a new product line with Claude Code | Eddie Kim (CTO)

不用 Figma、不用 Jira、不写文档，Gusto 如何用 Claude Code 打造新产品线 | Eddie Kim（CTO）

Listen now on YouTube • Spotify • Apple Podcasts

在 YouTube • Spotify • Apple Podcasts 收听本期节目。

Brought to you by:
Magic Patterns — Prototypes that look like your product
Jira Product Discovery — Prioritize with insights, build with confidence

赞助商：
Magic Patterns — 做出像你家产品一样的原型
Jira Product Discovery — 用洞察排优先级，自信地构建产品

Brought to you by:
  • Magic Patterns — Prototypes that look like your product
  • Jira Product Discovery — Prioritize with insights, build with confidence

本期由以下品牌赞助：

• Magic Patterns — 做出像你家产品一样的原型

• Jira Product Discovery — 用洞察排优先级，自信地构建产品

Eddie Kim is the co-founder and CTO of Gusto. In this episode, he shares how a five-person team used Claude Code, a permanent Zoom room, and almost none of the usual product process—no PM, no Figma, no Jira, no long specs—to build Gusto Cofounder from scratch in just 10 weeks.

Eddie Kim 是 Gusto 的联合创始人兼 CTO。在本期节目中，他分享了一个五人团队如何利用 Claude Code、一个常驻 Zoom 会议室，以及几乎没有任何常规产品流程——没有产品经理、没有 Figma、没有 Jira、没有冗长需求文档——在短短 10 周内从零打造 Gusto Cofounder。

Biggest takeaways:

核心要点：

  • A five-person team with no process can outship a large team with full process, if AI handles the engineering. Eddie’s product launched at Gusto’s tier-one level after 10 weeks, starting from zero code. The constraint wasn’t a liability—it was the design. When AI does the building, coordination overhead doesn’t scale the engineering; it just slows it down. The key: strip process to what the team actually needs, then let AI fill the gap.
  • “Zero code to tier-one launch” is now a viable founding path. The team reached a production milestone at Gusto without a line of pre-existing code. This flips the assumption that early teams spend months on infrastructure before shipping anything real. With Claude Code as the primary builder, the initial sprint becomes about direction and judgment, not typing. It compresses the time between idea validation and real user contact from months to weeks.
  • No meetings, no Jira, no text threads. It shipped anyway. The team had no standup cadence, no ticket system, no async thread to resolve blockers. What replaced all of that: shared context held inside the AI loop. When the model carries state and the team is small and aligned, human coordination overhead becomes optional.
  • The technical stack for a production AI agent is shockingly minimal. The entire agent loop ran on Cloudflare Workers with the Vercel AI SDK. Nothing else. No proprietary orchestration layer, no third-party agent framework. Everything else was built in-house. Teams often over-architect before they’ve proven anything; Eddie’s stack is evidence that infrastructure minimalism accelerates the path to learning what the agent actually needs to do.
  • Building agents is not as complicated as the community makes it sound. An agent is an AI SDK running somewhere in the cloud, able to look up files and call tools. That’s the full definition. The complexity people fear (state management, orchestration, reliability) is solvable with the same judgment calls any backend system requires. Eddie’s team shipped one at production quality in 10 weeks without specialist AI infrastructure experience.
  • The “permanent Zoom” model of AI development changes how teams think about context. Claude Code running in a persistent loop means the model has continuous access to the codebase’s current state. That’s closer to having an engineer who never closes their laptop than a chat interface you query on demand. For small teams, this is the equivalent of a senior engineer who is always available, always current, and never needs onboarding after a break.
  • The lesson for founding teams isn’t “use Claude Code.” It’s “design your process for AI as a team member.” Most early teams graft AI tools onto a human-scaled workflow: standups, tickets, PRs reviewed by three people. Eddie’s team treated the AI as a primary contributor from day one and built their coordination model around that assumption. The result: a workflow that gets faster as the AI improves, not one that merely offloads tasks to it.

1. 如果 AI 负责工程实现，一个五人无流程团队可以比一支流程齐全的大团队交付得更快。Eddie 的产品从零行代码开始，10 周后以 Gusto 内部“一级”产品的标准上线。限制不是负担，而是设计选择。当 AI 承担构建工作时，协调开销并不会放大工程产出，只会拖慢速度。关键是：把流程削减到团队真正需要的部分，然后让 AI 填补缺口。

2. “从零行代码到一级产品发布”如今已成为一条可行的创业路径。团队在 Gusto 实现了生产级里程碑，却没有一行预先存在的代码。这颠覆了早期团队必须先花几个月搭建基础设施才能上线真实产品的假设。当 Claude Code 作为主要构建者时，最初的冲刺关注的是方向和判断，而不是敲代码。它把从想法验证到接触真实用户的时间从几个月压缩到几周。

3. 没有会议、没有 Jira、没有文字线程。产品还是上线了。团队没有站会节奏，没有工单系统，没有异步消息来解阻塞。取而代之的，是 AI 循环中承载的共享上下文。当模型掌握状态，而团队规模小且目标一致时，人与人之间的协调开销变成了可选项。

4. 生产级 AI agent 的技术栈可以极简到令人惊讶。整个 agent 循环只运行在 Cloudflare Workers 上，使用 Vercel AI SDK。仅此而已。没有专有编排层，没有第三方 agent 框架，其余全部自研。团队常常在验证前就过度架构；Eddie 的技术栈证明，基础设施极简主义能加速你搞清楚 agent 真正需要做什么。

5. 构建 agent 并不像社区渲染的那么复杂。一个 agent 就是运行在云端某处的 AI SDK，能够查阅文件并调用工具。这就是完整定义。人们所担心的复杂性（状态管理、编排、可靠性）可以用任何后端系统都需要的那种判断来解决。Eddie 的团队在没有专业 AI 基础设施经验的情况下，10 周内就交付了一个生产质量的 agent。

6. “常驻 Zoom”式的 AI 开发改变了团队对上下文的理解。Claude Code 在一个持久循环中运行，意味着模型能持续访问代码库的最新状态。这更像是一位从不关电脑的工程师，而不是一个按需查询的聊天界面。对小团队来说，这相当于拥有一位随时在线、始终掌握最新情况、休息后也不需要重新 onboarding 的高级工程师。

7. 对创始团队的启示不是“用 Claude Code”，而是“把 AI 当作团队成员来设计流程”。大多数早期团队把 AI 工具嫁接在人类规模的工作流上：站会、工单、三人审 PR。Eddie 的团队从第一天起就把 AI 视为主要贡献者，并围绕这一假设构建协作模式。结果是：一个随着 AI 能力提升而加速的工作流，而不是一个仅仅把任务外包给 AI 的工作流。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: Ornith-1.0：用于智能体编码的自脚手架大语言模型
item.description:
标签: #大模型 #编程 #开源 #智能体

摘要: Ornith-1.0 是一款基于 Apache 2.0 许可的 Gemma 4 和 Qwen 3.5 构建的“自脚手架”大模型，提供 9B 到 397B 等多个参数版本，在同等规模开源模型中达到了领先的代码能力水平；作者通过 LM Studio 在本地试用了 35B 版本，发现其在多工具调用的 Agent 编程和代码检索等任务上表现非常出色。

原标题: Ornith-1.0: Self-Scaffolding LLMs for Agentic Coding

Ornith-1.0: Self-Scaffolding LLMs for Agentic Coding

Ornith-1.0：用于智能体编程（Agentic Coding）的自脚手架（Self-Scaffolding）大语言模型（LLMs）

[...] with variants including 9B Dense, 31B Dense, 35B MoE, and 397B MoE. Built on top of pretrained Gemma 4 and Qwen 3.5, it achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models of comparable size on coding benchmarks.

[……] 包括 9B Dense、31B Dense、35B MoE 和 397B MoE 等变体。它基于预训练的 Gemma 4 和 Qwen 3.5 构建，在同等规模的开源模型中，于编码基准测试上取得了最先进的性能。

[...] with variants including 9B Dense, 31B Dense, 35B MoE, and 397B MoE. Built on top of pretrained Gemma 4 and Qwen 3.5, it achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models of comparable size on coding benchmarks.

[……] 包括 9B Dense、31B Dense、35B MoE 和 397B MoE 等变体。它基于预训练的 Gemma 4 和 Qwen 3.5 构建，在同等规模的开源模型中，于编码基准测试上取得了最先进的性能。

As far as I can tell the licenses of those underlying models is compatible with being used in this way - Gemma 4 is Apache 2.0 licensed (and not bound by the janky additional Gemma Terms of Use that afflicted the previous Gemma models) and Qwen 3.5 is Apache 2.0 licensed as well.

据我所知，这些底层模型的许可证与这种使用方式是兼容的——Gemma 4 采用 Apache 2.0 许可证（并且不受困扰此前 Gemma 模型的那些蹩脚附加 Gemma 使用条款的约束），Qwen 3.5 同样采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。

I've been running the model using LM Studio and the ornith-1.0-35b-Q4_K_M.gguf (20GB) GGUF, hooked up to Pi. Initial impressions are very good - it seems to be able to run the agent harness over many tool calls in a proficient way.

我一直在使用 LM Studio 和 ornith-1.0-35b-Q4_K_M.gguf（20GB）GGUF 运行该模型，并将其连接到 Pi。初步印象非常好——它似乎能够以熟练的方式在多次工具调用上运行智能体框架。

Here's a terminal session where I asked it to "find the code that decodes the actor cookie" and then "find the code that opens the insert dialog when the button is clicked" against a Datasette checkout, which it handled with ease.

这里有一个终端会话，我在其中要求它针对一份 Datasette 代码检出执行“找到解码 actor cookie 的代码”以及“找到按钮点击时打开插入对话框的代码”，它都轻松完成了。

I also had it draw this pelican, which came out at 103 tokens/second:

我还让它画了这只鹈鹕，输出速度达到了每秒 103 个 token：

It's a little bit mangled but the pelican is clearly a pelican.

稍微有点变形，但那只鹈鹕显然就是鹈鹕。

I couldn't find much information about DeepReinforce themselves. The earliest paper I could find from them was CUDA-L1: Improving CUDA Optimization via Contrastive Reinforcement Learning from June 2025.

我找不到太多关于 DeepReinforce 本身的信息。我能找到的他们最早的论文是 2025 年 6 月的 CUDA-L1：通过 对比强化学习（Contrastive Reinforcement Learning）改进 CUDA 优化。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: 统计 Safari 标签页数量
item.description:
标签: #Safari #AppleScript #标签页 #浏览器

摘要: 作者分享了一个通过 AppleScript 统计 Safari 所有打开标签页数量的小技巧，并自嘲自己目前竟有 370 个标签页同时打开。

原标题: Count the number of Safari tabs

Count the number of Safari tabs

29th June 2026

2026 年 6 月 29 日

Tiniest TIL, using AppleScript to count the number of open browser tabs in Safari:

超小的一个今日所学（TIL，Today I Learned），使用 AppleScript 来统计 Safari 中打开的浏览器 标签页 数量：

osascript -e 'tell application "Safari" to count tabs of every window'

上述 osascript 命令会请求 Safari 统计每个窗口中的 标签页 数量并返回总数。

我在终端窗口中运行了该命令，返回结果是 370。
